content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: Protesters across the country have taken to the streets to voice their opposition to the recently introduced immigration reform bill, which would drastically change the legal pathways for immigrants.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: The bill, championed by Congresswoman Laura Green, proposes a points-based system for granting visas, emphasizing skills and education over family ties.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Advocates for immigrant rights argue that the bill would separate families and create an unfair system based on luck rather than need.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: Opponents, including business leaders, contend that the current system is inefficient and does not meet the workforce needs of the country.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: Lawyer Alex Thompson said, 'This bill ignores the contributions immigrants make to our society and economy.'

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: ‘Families should not be torn apart by policy,’ said Laura Green.
